recipe:xo-sauce-omelette-with-prawns-spr.en: XO Sauce Omelette with Prawns & Spring Onions
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them well with a fork or whisk until the yolks and whites are fully combined. Season well with a pinch of salt and plenty of black pepper.
Thinly slice and separate the spring onions into green and white parts. Add half the spring onion greens and a pinch of salt to the beaten eggs.

Heat half the butter in a medium or large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Once the butter is foaming, add the prawns and spring onion whites. Cook for 30 seconds, stirring until the prawns are opaque, turning pink and almost cooked through. Stir the XO sauce through and cook for 30 seconds until the prawns are fully cooked through.
Pop the cooked prawn mixture onto a plate and wipe out the pan. Heat the remaining butter in the pan over a medium-high heat and, once the butter is foaming, pour the egg mixture into the pan.

As the omelette begins to set around the edges, use a spatula to gently lift the edges and tilt the pan, all the while slightly shaking the pan to let the uncooked egg flow to the edges. Cook this way for around 1-2 mins.
Once the omelette is mostly set but still slightly runny on top, scatter the prawn mixture on top and carefully fold the other half over.
Slide the omelette onto a plate, season well to taste with salt and plenty of black pepper, then top with the remaining spring onion greens.

recipe:sweetcorn-fritters-2:step:0.en: Add the drained sweetcorn, spring onions, red chilli and fresh coriander and parsley to a blender and blitz until combined but still chunky. Add ⅓ egg and blitz again to combine.

recipe:sweetcorn-fritters-2:step:1.en: Add the chickpea flour and a pinch of salt and blitz again to a thick batter. Use a spoon to stir through ½ the Daily 30+ (if using). If the batter is too thin, add 1 tbsp of chickpea flour at a time until thickened.

recipe:sweetcorn-fritters-2:step:2.en: Heat a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add a couple tbsp of the sweetcorn mixture to the pan and cook for 2 mins on each side until golden and cooked through. Repeat for the remaining batter, cooking 2-3 fritters at a time.

recipe:sweetcorn-fritters-2:step:3.en: While the fritters are cooking, poach your eggs in boiling water to your liking (4 mins for runny yolks). Slice the avocado and halve the cherry tomatoes.

recipe:sweetcorn-fritters-2:step:4.en: To serve, stack the fritters and top with a tablespoon of Greek yoghurt and a poached egg. Serve with the sliced avocado and cherry tomatoes and an additional sprinkle of Daily 30+ (if using).

recipe:sweetcorn-fritters-2:ingredient:6.pt: 3 c. sopa de Farinha de Grão-de-Bico

recipe:10-minute-smoky-harissa-creamy-bu.en: Add the cherry tomatoes to a pan with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt. Set it over a medium-high heat and cook for about 5 mins until starting to soften and burst open. Add a splash of water if they’re catching on the bottom of the pan.
Mince the garlic and add it to the tomatoes in the pan along with the tomato paste, ¾ of the harissa and the smoked paprika.

Add the tinned butterbeans and ½ their liquid to the pan then stir in the vegan cream cheese. Bring the mixture to a boil then turn down the heat and simmer for 5-10 mins until the beans have softened and the broth has thickened (it should be creamy).
Meanwhile, toast the bread and finely chop the herbs.
Ladle the beans into bowls or meal-prep boxes. Drizzle over the tahini and some remaining harissa. Finish with the chopped herbs and flaked almonds. It will keep in the fridge for 3 days.

recipe:smoky-mushroom-maple-bagel:step:1.en: Slice the mushrooms to about half a centimetre thick and place in a wide, shallow bowl or large tupperware box.

recipe:smoky-mushroom-maple-bagel:step:2.en: Mix the olive oil, maple syrup, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, smoked paprika, miso, and black pepper until combined to make the marinade.

recipe:smoky-mushroom-maple-bagel:step:3.en: Pour the marinade over the mushrooms and carefully mix to make sure each slice is covered.

recipe:smoky-mushroom-maple-bagel:step:4.en: Lay the mushrooms out onto baking paper on a large baking tray. If you have a wire rack, this will help them cook more evenly. Roast at 180°C for 10 mins, flipping halfway through. Alternatively, air fry for 6 mins at 180°C.

recipe:smoky-mushroom-maple-bagel:step:5.en: To serve, slice the bagel open and toast in the oven or on a hot pan until crispy. Slice your tomato. Spread vegan cream cheese, if using, on the bottom half of the bagel, then layer up the mushrooms, tomato, and lettuce on top. Spread the mayo onto the top half, close, and enjoy.

recipe:keralan-inspired-prawn-curry:step.en: Thinly slice the banana shallots. Cut the ginger into matchsticks. Mince the garlic. Thinly slice the green chilli. Finely chop the tomatoes.
Melt 2 tbsp coconut oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shallots and curry leaves and cook until the shallots have softened, around 5 mins.

Add the garlic, ginger and green chillies and cook for 1 minute then add the Kashmiri chilli powder, ground turmeric and ground coriander and cook for 30 seconds. This will help prevent the spices from burning.
Wash the rice then top it up with water, and put it on in a pot on the hob with the lid on for 10 minutes until fluffy.
Add in the tomatoes, 150ml water and tamarind paste and season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine, cover and simmer over a low heat for 10 mins. You should end up with quite a thick curry.
Stir in the prawns, cover and simmer over a low heat until they’re cooked through, 3 to 5 mins.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp coconut oil in a small frying pan. Add the mustard seeds and cook for 1 minute then add the curry leaves and cook until beginning to crisp.
Pour the mustard seeds and curry leaves over the curry, then tear over the coriander.
Serve with a generous bowl of rice.

recipe:spicy-egg-cheese-breakfast-sandos.en: Heat the oven to fan 180°C. Grease and line a 20x20cm baking tray.

Make the chutney: Roughly chop the chillies and ginger. Pick the mint leaves and discard the stems. Add the coriander, stalks and all, into a blender with the rest of the ingredients and a pinch of salt and sugar. Add the oil and blend together until smooth. Then, season to taste with lemon juice, black pepper and more salt and sugar, if needed.
Break up the hash browns into 1cm pieces and cut the cheddar into 1cm cubes. Add them to your prepared baking tray.

Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk together with the salt and crème fraîche, then tip into the tray, over the hashbrown and cheddar pieces. Swirl through ½ the chutney, then slide into the oven to bake for 25-30 mins until the edges have puffed but the centre is still slightly wobbly. Remove from the oven and leave the eggs to cool slightly before transferring to a chopping board until cool enough to handle (10-15 mins). Cut into 12 even portions.
If eating straight away, toast the rolls (skip this step if making ahead). Spread ketchup on one of the sides and chutney on the other. Sandwich the egg in between.
If making ahead, wrap each sandwich in baking paper and freeze for up to 3 months. Before serving, microwave on high for bursts of 30 secs, until heated throughout.

recipe:lemon-poppy-seed-sunshine-pots:st.en: In a small bowl, stir together the lemon curd, turmeric, cinnamon, and cardamom.
Zest the lemon and then, in a separate bowl, mix the lemon zest and poppy seeds into the Greek yoghurt.
Gently swirl the spiced lemon curd through the yoghurt, being careful not to fully mix – you want a marbled effect.
Divide the mixture between jars or containers, cover, and refrigerate until needed.

recipe:harissa-chicken:step:0.en: Roughly cut the chicken thighs into chunky strips and whack them in a bowl with 2/3 of the yoghurt and 2/3 of the harissa paste. Season with salt and pepper then massage the mixture into the chicken.

recipe:harissa-chicken:step:1.en: Cook the couscous to packet instructions. Run a fork through the grains once cooked then cover with a chopping board or clean tea towel until ready to serve.

recipe:harissa-chicken:step:2.en: Heat a glug of oil in a frying pan set over a medium heat then get the chicken in, stirring occasionally and leaving to cook for around 12 minutes.

recipe:harissa-chicken:step:3.en: Chop your mint and coriander and finely slice your cucumber. Add the herbs and cucumber to the couscous with the juice of the lime. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine.

recipe:harissa-chicken:step:4.en: Divide the couscous between four plates then top with the chicken, a dollop of yoghurt, a drizzle of the remaining harissa and the chopped herbs.

recipe:honey-harissa-carrot-couscous-wit.en: Honey Harissa Carrot Couscous with Feta Dressing
Preheat the oven to 190°C fan. Halve the carrots lengthways and cut into 4cm pieces.
In a small bowl, mix the honey and harissa.
Toss the carrots with a splash of olive oil, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper. Spread onto a baking tray and roast for 20-25 mins.
Pat dry the chickpeas and add them to the baking tray. Roast for another 15 mins until crispy. Once cooked, toss with the harissa-honey mixture.
Meanwhile, place the couscous in a bowl, season with salt, and cover with boiling water. Place a plate on top to trap the steam and let sit for 5 mins. Fluff with a fork
Mix the couscous with chopped parsley and chopped olives Season to taste.
In a blender, blitz the feta, Greek yoghurt, and lemon juice until smooth. Season with salt and black pepper.
To serve, divide the couscous into serving boxes, top with the roasted carrots, roasted chickpeas, and drizzle with the feta dressing. Refrigerate until needed. No need to reheat before serving.

recipe:mallika-basus-butter-chicken-curr.en: Turn the grill on to high. Make the chicken tikka first. Chop the chicken into 2-3cm chunks and finely grate the ginger and garlic. Put into a bowl along with the rest of the tikka ingredients. Mix together.

Line a baking tray with foil and drizzle over some oil. Spread the chicken pieces onto it, then slide under the hot grill. Grill until fully cooked, and starting to char, 10-15 mins - every grill if different, so it may take a little less or more time.
Get your Tilda Pure Basmati rice on - cook according to packet instructions for the best results.

To make the curry, put the passata and sour cream into a heavy-based pan and stir well. Place over a low heat, adding the chilli powder and garam masala and finally the butter. As it starts bubbling, tip the chicken into the pan, along with their juices and the fenugreek leaves. If the curry starts splattering, loosely cover it with a lid.

Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until you see the butter oozing through the curry and the colour deepens to a rich red. Add salt to your taste. Sprinkle with fresh coriander. Serve on a bed of steaming hot basmati rice.

recipe:smashed-chicken-tacos-pineapple-s.en: Smashed Chicken Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
Grate the onion into a large bowl. Add the chicken mince, grated mozzarella and spices. Season with salt and pepper and mix to combine.

Lay out the tortillas and divide the chicken mix between them. Use a fork to smash the chicken into the tortilla, making sure to go right to the edge. If making ahead, stack the tortillas up between sheets of greaseproof paper in a container and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days or the freezer (covered in foil) for up to 3 months.

To make the salsa, dice the jalapeño, pineapple and red onion and chop the coriander. Mix together and season with lime juice, hot sauce and salt to taste. If making ahead, transfer to a container and store in the fridge for up to 3 days.

When ready to eat, finely shred the cabbage, slice the avocado and crumble the feta. Heat a medium sized non-stick frying pan over a high heat. Once hot, add a little olive oil and place the taco, chicken side down, into the pan. Cook over a medium heat for 4-6 mins until nicely browned. Flip and crisp up the tortilla.
Plate up with the salsa, avocado, cabbage, feta and a wedge of lime. Douse in your favourite hot sauce and enjoy!

recipe:lunch-box-harissa-chicken-traybak.en: Harissa Chicken Traybake with Herby Grains
Heat the oven grill to high.
Cut the chicken thighs into quarters. Peel and finely slice the onions. Grate the garlic.
Add the chicken, onions, harissa and grated garlic to a large bowl. Drizzle in some olive oil, season with salt and black pepper, and toss to coat.

Tip everything onto a baking tray and spread into an even layer. Slide under the grill on the top shelf and cook for 15–20 mins, turning halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and the edges are starting to catch.
While that grills, dice the courgette. Finely chop the dill and parsley.
Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Chuck in the courgette and fry for 6–8 mins until golden and soft, seasoning as you go.
Tip in the grains and stir through until hot. Take off the heat, then stir through the herbs and squeeze in the juice of half a lemon. Taste and tweak the seasoning if it needs it.
Serve the grilled chicken and onions over the herby grains with a big spoonful of Skyr yoghurt on the side.

recipe:creamy-miso-tahini-udon:step:0.en: Chop the spring onions into large chunks and the mushrooms into thick slices.

recipe:creamy-miso-tahini-udon:step:1.en: Cook the spring onions in a large pan on a high heat for 5 mins until charred before removing them and setting them aside. Add in the mushrooms with a big glug of oil and cook for 8-10 mins until browned. Keep the mushrooms in the pan with the heat off.

recipe:creamy-miso-tahini-udon:step:2.en: Separate your egg yolks and whites. In a bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, parmesan, miso paste, tahini, chilli flakes and fresh black pepper. Grate in the ginger and add in the soy sauce.

recipe:creamy-miso-tahini-udon:step:3.en: Cook the udon in boiling water according to package instructions. Ladle in 150ml of the cooking liquid into the egg mixture, whisking continuously so the eggs do not scramble.

recipe:creamy-miso-tahini-udon:step:4.en: With the heat off, add the udon to the mushroom pan before throwing in the spring onions and egg mixture and tossing well to coat the noodles. Next, turn the heat on the lowest setting and continue mixing to create a thick and glossy sauce. Season with salt if needed.

recipe:creamy-miso-tahini-udon:step:5.en: Serve the noodles on a plate with some more parmesan and black pepper. Enjoy

recipe:easy-crepe-recipe:step:0.en: Tip the flour into a bowl along with a pinch of salt. Crack in the egg, pour in the milk and whisk everything together until a smooth, thin batter. Leave for at least 15 mins or cover with a plate/kitchen foil and leave in the fridge for up to overnight.

recipe:easy-crepe-recipe:step:1.en: Heat a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and add a little knob of butter. Swirl it round the pan to completely cover the base. Take a full large ladleful of the batter and pour it into the pan, instantly tipping the pan and moving the batter around so it completely covers the base in a thin, even layer.

recipe:easy-crepe-recipe:step:2.en: Cook for one minute until the batter has set and is free from the pan and lightly golden. Flip the pancake in one movement, or use a spatula, and cook for another minute.

recipe:easy-crepe-recipe:step:3.en: Slide out onto a plate and scatter over a good coating of the sugar and squeeze over the juice of as much lemon as you like. Repeat.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:0.en: Rinse the rice under cold water 2–3 times until the water runs clear. Add it to a lidded saucepan with the water and a pinch of salt. Set over a medium heat. Once it starts to simmer, cover with the lid, reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 mins. Remove from the heat and leave to steam for 10 mins. Fluff with a fork.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:1.en: Meanwhile, peel and finely slice the onion. Peel the garlic and ginger and grate both into a bowl. Add the sriracha, honey, soy sauce and rice vinegar, and stir to make your sauce.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:2.en: Thinly slice the red chillies. Trim and finely slice the spring onions.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:3.en: Set a large frying pan over a medium heat with the oil. Once hot, add the onion and cook for 3–4 mins until softened.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:4.en: Turn the heat up to high, add the beef mince and cook for 3–4 mins, breaking it up with a wooden spoon until browned.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:5.en: Pour in the sauce and let it bubble for 2–3 mins until thickened and sticky. Stir in the red chillies and cook for 1 more min.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:6.en: Add the tenderstem to a heatproof bowl, cover and microwave for 2 mins until just tender.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl:step:7.en: Divide the rice between bowls. Top with the sticky beef and broccoli, then finish with the spring onion greens.

1 colher de sopa de Molho de Soja

recipe:high-protein-air-fryer-granola:st.en: If the coconut oil is solid, melt it in a saucepan over a low heat. Alternatively pop it in the microwave in a microwave-safe bowl for 15 seconds at a time, stirring between each burst until completely melted.
Crush the hazelnuts with a large knife then chop into small pieces. Add to a large bowl along with all the other ingredients, except the egg whites.
Add the egg whites to a separate large bowl and whisk until soft and fluffy (this will take around 4-5 mins with a hand whisk). Gently fold the egg white through the dry ingredients.
Add the uncooked granola to the air fryer tray in a single layer (you might need to do this in batches). Cook for 15-20 mins, mixing halfway, until completely golden and toasty.
Leave to cool before serving immediately, or storing in an airtight container for up to 10 days.

recipe:3-ingredient-banana-pancakes-2:st.en: Crack the eggs into a blender then add the bananas and oats. Turn the blender onto a medium speed and blitz for 1-2 mins until the mixture is homogeneous and semi-smooth. Let it sit for 3 mins.
Warm a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Once hot, turn the heat down to low and add a small knob of butter. Once melted, add 4 tbsp of the mixture (for one large pancake).

Cook over a low heat for 1-2 mins until bubbles begin to appear. Flip and cook for another minute on the other side. Remove to a plate and cover with kitchen foil (or pop in the bottom shelf of a warm oven) to keep warm until serving. Repeat for the remaining mixture.
Serve with your choice of toppings! More banana slices, peanut butter and flaked toasted almonds are great.

recipe:broccoli-pesto-pasta-with-whipped.en: Broccoli Pesto Pasta with Whipped Lemon Tofu
Using a food processor, a knife or a pestle and mortar, pulse the basil and pine nuts with a pinch of salt until just pulverised. You want to keep some of the pine nuts chunky.
Using the largest side of a box grater, grate the whole broccoli, stem and florets, leaving only the very tough end. Grate the garlic on the smallest side.
Cook the broccoli and garlic in a large pan with half th olive oil and a pinch of salt, on medium high, for about 8 mins until it’s starting to char.
Add the basil and pine nuts to the pan and cook for another 2-3 mins.

Meanwhile, cook your pasta as per package instructions. Drain and keep a cup of pasta water. Stir the pasta gently through the broccoli pesto in the pan. Add a splash of pasta water and plenty of olive oil.

To make the whipped lemon tofu, add the tofu, juice of the lemons, the remaining olive oil, miso, nutritional yeast, garlic powder and water to a blender. Blend until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper. You may need to add more water to loosen it up depending on the brand of tofu you are using.

To serve, spoon a generous amount of the whipped tofu onto the bottom of a plate, then layer over the pasta and finish with some lemon zest, plenty of black pepper and a drizzle of olive oil. Add a few basil leaves and a handful of pine nuts to finish, if you like.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:0.en: Prepare the tomatoes. Cut the stem out of any big vine tomatoes and cut into chunks. Mix together with the cherry tomatoes.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:1.en: Get your oil in an oven safe frying pan over a medium heat. If you don't have one, a regular frying pan will be fine! Just transfer the food to a baking dish a few steps down. Slice your garlic and add into the pan along with the chilli flakes, cook for a couple of minutes.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:2.en: Add in the tomatoes, cook until they begin to break up and bubble down into a fresh tomato sauce. Add in the basil.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:3.en: Add the gnocchi to a bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 5 minutes, then drain, reserving some of the gnocchi water. Heat the grill to high.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:4.en: Drain the gnocchi and add into the tomato sauce with a slosh of the gnocchi water. Stir together and bubble down in the pan for a couple of minutes until you have a nice thick gnocchi sauce. Season with salt and pepper and tear in the basil.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:5.en: Pour the gnocchi into a baking dish if you aren't already using an oven safe pan. Tear up the mozzarella and scatter over the top.

recipe:caprese-gnocchi-bake:step:6.en: Place under the grill for 7-8 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbling. Remove, serve up and scatter with more basil if you like.

recipe:blueberry-almond-smoothie-bowl:st.en: Chuck the blueberries, blackberries, banana, milk, yoghurt, protein powder, almond butter, the juice of the lime and chia seeds into a blender.
Start blending on a low speed. Use a tamper to push everything down – it’ll be thick. Add 10ml more milk at a time only if it really won’t blend.
Scoop into a bowl and load up with your favourite toppings – fresh berries, granola, almonds, seeds or another drizzle of almond butter.

recipe:mushroom-miso-ramen-lunch-pots:st.en: Use a speed peeler to peel the carrot into thin ribbons. Finely slice the shiitake mushrooms and the spring onions. Chop up your tofu into even-sized cubes.
Add ¼ of the miso, soy sauce, sesame oil and chilli flakes into each pot and stir to combine. Layer the rest of the ingredients into the pots. You can break up the noodles if needed.
When ready to eat, add 470ml of boiling water to each pot and set aside for 5 mins to cook the noodles and soften the veg.

recipe:fried-chilli-pork-and-green-beans.en: Fried Chilli Pork and Green Beans
Finely slice your red chillies. Finely chop your garlic. Take the ends off the green beans, then cut them in half. Cut your spring onions into 4cm lengths.

Heat your wok over a medium heat with a splash of vegetable oil. Add your pork and season with salt. Stir fry for about 5 mins, or until the pork is browned and the liquid has evaporated off. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
Add your green beans, sliced chilli and spring onions to the same pan and fry for 3 mins, or until softened and charred. Add your garlic to the pan and cook for 30 seconds.
Get your pork back into the pan, along with your soy sauce, sugar and a pinch of white pepper. Pour in the water and bring it to a gentle simmer.
Bring a pan of water to a boil. Cook your noodles according to packet instructions, then drain.
Mix your cornflour with a splash of water to make a slurry then pour this into the pork mixture. Give it a good mix.
Allow the sauce thicken and the flavours to mingle by simmering for 3 mins. Adjust the seasoning if need be.
Toss the noodles through the pork mixture and share between plates.
