1 colher de sopa de Amido de Milho

recipe:honey-garlic-chicken-broccoli-ric.en: Honey Garlic Chicken with Broccoli Rice
Heat the oven to 200°C. Dice the broccoli into small pieces. Cook the rice following pack instructions, adding the broccoli 3 mins before the end of the cooking time.
Meanwhile, thinly slice the spring onions. Dice the chicken into 3cm pieces. In a bowl or flat tray, mix the garlic powder, chilli powder, flour and a pinch of salt.
Toss the chicken in the mix to coat evenly, then transfer to a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil. Slide into the hot oven to roast for 15-20 mins, until cooked through.

Mince the garlic then add to a bowl along with the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and the juice of the limes. Mix to combine then pour over the chicken and pop it back in the oven for another 5 mins until sticky.
Box or plate up the broccoli rice, top with the sticky chicken, and drizzle over any remaining sauce. Scatter over the spring onions and sesame seeds. It will keep well in the fridge for 3 days.

recipe:honey-garlic-chicken-broccoli-ric.pt: 8 Coxas de Frango sem Osso e sem Pele
1 colher de sopa de Alho em Pó
0,5 colher de sopa de Pimentão em Pó
2 colheres de sopa de Molho de Soja
2 colheres de sopa de Sementes de Sésamo

recipe:cauliflower-with-harissa-tahini-a.en: Cauliflower With Harissa Tahini And Lentils

Add the water to a pot with the lentils and bring to a boil. Simmer for 15 mins, covered. 
Add the rice and stock cube and cook for another 12-15 mins or until cooked. Drizzle with plenty of olive oil, salt and pepper and mix well.

Chop the cauliflower into small pieces, including the stem. Drizzle with oil, salt and pepper and za’atar, if using. Air fry at 190°C for 10 mins or roast in the oven at 180°C for 25 mins until golden and crispy.
Slice the very tough, large stems off of the cauliflower leaves and toss in a little oil and season. Air fry for 3 mins at 180°C or roast with the florets for 8-10 mins or until crispy.

To make the tahini sauce, whisk together the tahini with 120-150ml cold water. It will congeal but don’t worry – keep whisking and adding water until it turns into a creamy consistency. Add the harissa and season with salt and pepper.
To serve, lay the lentils and rice on a plate and top with the cauliflower and a good drizzle of tahini sauce. Feel free to scatter some pomegranate seeds on top as well, if you like.
For meal prep, keep the lentils and rice with the cauliflower, and keep the tahini sauce separate until ready to serve.

recipe:sticky-honey-miso-aubergine-rice:.en: Sticky Honey & Miso Aubergine Rice Bowl

Cut the aubergines into wedges and place them on a baking tray. In a bowl, mix the honey, miso, water, sesame oil and lemon juice, then pour over the aubergines, tossing to coat. Roast for 30-35 mins until soft and sticky. Once cooked, remove from the oven and drizzle over the pomegranate molasses.
Meanwhile, cook the rice following pack instructions. Four mins before the end of the cooking time, add the green beans. Slice the red chilli and pick the parsley leaves.

Divide the rice between bowls or meal prep containers. Top with the sticky aubergines, drizzling over any leftover marinade from the tray. Scatter with sesame seeds, red chilli and parsley. Finish with pomegranate seeds, if using. It will keep well in the fridge for 3 days.

recipe:sticky-beef-mince-brothy-rice:ste.en: Thinly slice the onion and chuck it into a bowl of ice-cold water. Leave it to crisp up while you crack on with everything else. Bash the ginger with the side of your knife and gently crush the cardamom pods.

Place a saucepan over a medium-high heat and toast the star anise and cardamom for about a minute until fragrant. Add the ginger and a small drizzle of olive oil. Let it sizzle for 30 seconds, then pour in the beef stock. Bring to the boil, turn the heat down and leave to gently simmer.
Place a frying pan over a high heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Add the beef mince and cook, breaking it up, until well browned and starting to crisp.

Mix the oyster sauce, sugar, sriracha, beef stock, soy sauce and rice vinegar together in a small bowl. Pour the sauce into the pan with the beef and let it bubble and reduce until sticky and caramelised, taste and season with salt and pepper if needed. Then finish by stirring through the butter.
Divide the hot rice between bowls. Just before serving, season the broth with lime juice and fish sauce, to taste. Ladle over the hot broth onto the rice, then top with the beef.
Serve with the sliced onion, coriander and sliced red chilli, and some extra lime wedges on the side if you fancy some more zing. Dig in!

recipe:sticky-beef-mince-brothy-rice:ing.pt: 2 Saquetas de 250g de Arroz para Micro-ondas

recipe:thai-red-curry-salmon-bites-with-.en: Thai Red Curry Salmon with Lime & Coconut Rice
Zest both limes onto a small plate and set aside.
In a bowl, mix the Thai red curry paste, honey and the juice of both limes with 50ml of water. Season lightly with salt and pepper.

Wash the rice thoroughly in cold water, then drain really well. Tip into a small saucepan and pour in the coconut milk. Add the lime zest and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid and cook for 5 mins. Lay the trimmed green beans on top, cover again and cook for another 5 mins. Turn off the heat and let everything steam for a few more minutes with the lid on.
Cut the salmon into chunky, bite-sized pieces and season with salt.

Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the salmon pieces and fry for 1 min on each side until golden. Turn the heat to low and pour in the curry dressing. Let it bubble away until thickened and sticky, coating the salmon.
Fluff the coconut and lime rice with a fork and divide between bowls or containers. Add the green beans, top with the sticky salmon bites and scatter over the coriander.

recipe:thai-red-curry-salmon-bites-with-.pt: 4 c. sopa de Pasta de Caril Vermelho Tailandês

recipe:crispy-bacon-egg-high-protein-sma.en: Crispy Bacon & Egg High Protein Smash

Bring a saucepan of water to the boil and gently lower in the eggs. Boil for 10 mins, then transfer to cold water to cool. Peel the eggs, separate the yolks from the whites, roughly chop the whites and set aside.

Heat the oven to 200°C. Lay the bacon rashers and cherry tomatoes on a baking tray and roast for 10–12 mins, until the bacon is crisp and the tomatoes are blistered. Leave everything to cool slightly, then chop the bacon into small pieces.

Add the egg yolks to a bowl with the cream cheese and feta and mash together until smooth and creamy. Fold through the chopped egg whites, bacon, roasted tomatoes. Slice the spring onion (reserving a handful to garnish) and stir though. Season well with salt and black pepper and mix until thick and scoopable.
To serve, scoop generous rounds of the smoosh onto hot toasted bread and finish with more sliced spring onion.

recipe:crispy-bacon-egg-high-protein-sma.pt: 2 Fatias de Pão de Fermentação Natural (para servir)

recipe:crispy-mushroom-black-bean-tacos:.en: Crispy Mushroom & Black Bean Tacos with Pea Guacamole

Heat the oven to 200°C. Roughly chop the mushrooms and put them in a small baking dish. Add all of the mushroom spices and plenty of olive oil, salt and black pepper. Toss to combine and roast for 25-30 mins until golden and caramelised, stirring at least twice to get an even cook.

Meanwhile, make the beans. Finely slice the onion and mince the garlic. Fry the onion in a large saucepan with a little olive oil for 8-10 mins until softened, then add the garlic. Add the tomato purée, soy sauce and spices and cook for a few more minutes until all the flavours have combined.

Add the sun-dried tomatoes and drained beans. Rinse the bean tin and fill it halfway with water, then add this to the pan. Simmer for about 10 mins until most of the liquid has evaporated and the beans have really softened.
To make the pea guacamole, defrost the peas and then put all of the ingredients into a small blender and blitz until almost smooth. Set aside.

To assemble, brush one side of the tortillas with olive oil and heat on this side in a large frying pan. Fill one half of each tortilla with the beans and mushrooms, then close them up. Fry them in the pan over a medium heat for 2 mins on each side until crispy on both sides.
Serve with the pea guacamole, some extra lime and pickles, if you like.

recipe:marry-me-spaghetti-meatballs:step.en: Finely dice the onion, crush the garlic cloves and slice the sundried tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.

Pour a glug of oil from the sundried tomato jar into a large pan over a medium heat. Add the meatballs and fry for about 10 mins or until the meatballs are nicely browned and cooked through. Transfer the meatballs to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, set a large saucepan of boiling water over a high heat then add the stock cube and stir to dissolve.
Return the empty meatball pan to the hob and reduce the heat to low-medium. Add another splash of the sundried tomato oil then add the onion and garlic and fry for about 7 mins until softened.
Drop your spaghetti into the boiling water and cook following packet instructions.

Add the sundried tomatoes, oregano, thyme, pesto, salt and pepper to the pan with the onion and garlic. Toss the meatballs back in and stir to coat then pour in the cream and a couple of ladles of pasta water. Stir and bring to a gentle simmer.
Drain the cooked spaghetti then add to the pan with the sauce, along with ½ the chopped basil and a splash of the pasta cooking water. Mix well to combine.
To serve, divide the spaghetti between bowls and top with the remaining basil and some grated Parmesan.

recipe:marry-me-spaghetti-meatballs:ingr.pt: 1 colher de chá de Orégãos Secos
1 colher de chá de Tomilho Seco
2 colheres de sopa de Pesto Vermelho Light

recipe:pink-power-smoothie-bowl:step:0.en: Chuck the frozen strawberries, raspberries, cherries and banana into a blender with the almond milk, yoghurt, protein powder, lime juice and chia seeds.

recipe:pink-power-smoothie-bowl:step:1.en: Start blending on a low speed. Use a tamper to push the mixture down towards the blades – it’ll take a minute to get going. Don’t add more liquid unless you absolutely have to. If it really won’t budge, splash in 10ml more almond milk at a time.

recipe:pink-power-smoothie-bowl:step:2.en: Scoop your thick smoothie into a bowl, then top with whatever you fancy – sliced fruit, coconut flakes, granola, seeds or a drizzle of almond butter.

recipe:pink-power-smoothie-bowl:ingredie.pt: 30g de Proteína em Pó de Baunilha

recipe:high-protein-breakfast-smoothie:s.en: Add all the ingredients to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. If you prefer a thinner consistency, add a splash of extra almond milk. Squeeze in some lemon juice for a little extra zing and pour it out into a bowl.
Finish with your toppings. We've gone for some fruit, granola, peanut butter, a drizzle of honey and more chia seeds for extra crunch. But add whatever you fancy.

recipe:high-protein-breakfast-smoothie:i.pt: 50g de Proteína em Pó de Baunilha

recipe:one-pot-miso-butter-cod-rice:step.en: Make sure your butter is at room temperature. Prep your ingredients: Wash the rice until the water runs clear, then place into a bowl, cover with water and leave to soak. Season the cod with salt and pepper then place onto kitchen paper. Finely slice or tear the mushrooms into 1cm chunks. Stir the softened butter, miso and mirin together in a bowl and set aside.

Place a frying pan (with a lid) onto medium-high heat with a generous drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the mushrooms and cook for 10-15 mins until browned, stirring only a couple of times. Transfer the mushrooms to a plate. Don’t wash the pan.

Drain the rice then tip it into the empty frying pan. Set over a high heat and pour over the stock. Bring the mixture to the boil then place the lid on and turn the heat down to low. Leave to cook for 12 mins.
When the rice cooking time is up, pat the cod dry and place the fillets on top of the rice. Spread the miso butter onto the fish then cover with a lid and cook for another 10 mins.
Meanwhile, heat the grill to high. Trim and cut the spring onions into thirds then thinly slice lengthwise and place into a bowl of ice water until curly.

When the fish cooking time is up, remove the lid and scatter the crispy mushrooms onto the rice. Slide the pan under the grill for 3-4 mins until the miso butter has started to colour and the fish is fully cooked through.
Drain the spring onions and toss with the sesame seeds and oil in a small bowl. Fluff the rice using a fork and spoon into bowls. Top with the fish and spring onion slaw.

recipe:one-pot-miso-butter-cod-rice:ingr.pt: 3 colheres de sopa de Miso Branco
2 colheres de chá de Sementes de Sésamo Tostadas
1 colher de chá de Óleo de Sésamo Tostado

recipe:marry-me-chicken-pasta-bake-meal-.en: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook until al dente, following pack instructions. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Meanwhile, slice the cherry tomatoes in half and tear the basil leaves.

Add the cottage cheese, sundried tomato paste, gochujang and garlic powder to a blender along with a splash of the reserved pasta water. Blend until smooth and creamy. Add more water as needed to loosen.

Tip the drained pasta into a large bowl along with the cooked chicken, halved cherry tomatoes and basil. Pour over the sauce and stir everything together until well coated. Add more pasta water if it looks a bit dry.

Transfer the pasta to an ovenproof dish, grate the Parmesan over the top and place under a hot grill for 5–10 mins until golden and bubbling on top. Once cooled, box up and pop in the fridge, ready for tomorrow’s lunch – they’ll keep for up to 3 days.

recipe:marry-me-chicken-pasta-bake-meal-.pt: 1 colher de sopa de Tomate Seco
1 colher de chá de Alho em Pó

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl-2:step.en: Rinse the rice under cold water 2–3 times until the water runs clear. Add it to a lidded saucepan with the water and a pinch of salt. Set over a medium heat. Once it starts to simmer, cover with the lid, reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 mins. Remove from the heat and leave to steam for 10 mins. Fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile, peel and finely slice the onion. Peel the garlic and ginger and grate both into a bowl. Add the sriracha, honey, soy sauce and rice vinegar, and stir to make your sauce.
Thinly slice the red chillies. Trim and finely slice the spring onions.
Set a large frying pan over a medium heat with the oil. Once hot, add the onion and cook for 3–4 mins until softened.
Turn the heat up to high, add the beef mince and cook for 3–4 mins, breaking it up with a wooden spoon until browned.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble for 2–3 mins until thickened and sticky. Stir in the red chillies and cook for 1 more min.
Add the tenderstem to a heatproof bowl, cover and microwave for 2 mins until just tender.
Divide the rice between containers. Top with the sticky beef and broccoli, then finish with the spring onion greens. Box up and pop in the fridge until needed.

recipe:firecracker-beef-rice-bowl-2:ingr.pt: 1 colher de sopa de Óleo Neutro
1 colher de sopa de Molho de Soja
1 colher de sopa de Vinagre de Arroz

recipe:aubergine-and-mascarpone-gnocchi-.en: Cut your aubergine into 3cm chunks. Finely chop your rosemary.
Tip your aubergines into a large baking tray with your cherry tomatoes and gnocchi. Add a good glug of olive oil, your chopped rosemary, chilli flakes and salt, then give it a good mix.
Roast in the oven for 45 mins, tossing every so often so that everything cooks evenly. The gnocchi should be crispy and the aubergines super soft.
Add your mascarpone, lemon zest and juice and parmesan to a bowl. Give everything a really good mix, loosening with the water to make it saucy.
Remove your baking tray from the oven. Remove the vines from your tomatoes, then pour in your mascarpone mixture. Mix to combine.
Sprinkle with basil, a little more parmesan and chilli flakes, then serve.

recipe:cheese-scones:step:0.en: Dice your butter and put in the freezer for 15 mins, then grate the cheese and finely chop the chives. To a large bowl add flour, salt, black pepper (30 turns on a grinder) and baking powder, bicarb and sugar. Mix well. Get your butter out of the freezer and, using a butter knife, chop into the flour until you have pea-sized pieces — you can also use your hands but you need to work quickly! Make a well in the mixture and add three-quarters of your cheddar cheese along with your chives, mustard powder and buttermilk, folding with a spatula until combined.

recipe:cheese-scones:step:1.en: Tip out onto a clean surface and form the dough into a circle. Lightly flour the surface and roll the dough into a rectangle about 36 x 18 cm. Fold the top ⅓ of the dough down into the middle, then fold the bottom ⅓ up to cover it, like folding a pamphlet. Turn the dough 90° and using a rolling pin, roll back out into a rectangle around 36 x 18 cm. Repeat. Cut the dough into 6 equal pieces, pop onto a tray, and cover with cling film before putting back into the fridge for 20 mins. Take the cream cheese out of the fridge and bring to room temp.

recipe:cheese-scones:step:2.en: In the meantime, heat the oven to 220°C. Once the dough has chilled, transfer to a lined baking tray and brush with milk. Sprinkle with the cheese and your chosen seeds or spice mix (the recipe for the everything bagel seasoning is here) and bake for 25-30 mins until golden and cooked through.

recipe:cheese-scones:step:3.en: Whilst the scones are cooking, finely chop the spring onions and chives. Mix the onions into the cream cheese and save the chives for serving. When the scones are cool enough to handle, spread with cream cheese and sprinkle with chives.

recipe:spaghetti-with-spicy-tomato-and-p.en: Spaghetti with Spicy Tomato & Pepper Sauce
Grab a blender, drain the peppers and add them along with the tomatoes, then whizz until almost smooth.
Place a big frying pan over a medium low heat, add the olive oil and then either very finely chop, crush or grate your garlic cloves and add them.

Cook the garlic very gently in the oil until fragrant but not coloured (about 2 mins), add the chilli and cook for another 30 seconds, then pour in the pepper and tomato mix and add a big pinch of salt.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for about 15 mins. While the sauce bubbles away gently, cook your spaghetti in a big pan of well salted water until al dente.

Transfer the pasta to the pan with the tomato and pepper sauce and mix it really well so that the spaghetti is well coated and glossy. Turn off the heat, add about 1/3rd of your grated cheese and mix gently until the cheese has melted into the sauce. You might need to loosen it up with a splash of pasta water.
Taste now and add salt if needed, then plate up into warm bowls and top with the remaining cheese and some black pepper.

recipe:korean-marinated-eggs:step:0.en: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil over a high heat. Once boiling, gently add fridge cold eggs to the hot water and simmer for 6 mins. Remove from the water and place straight into iced water to cool. Once cool enough to handle, peel the eggs.

recipe:korean-marinated-eggs:step:1.en: To make the marinade, finely mince the garlic and finely slice the spring onions and chillies. Add to a container, along with all the remaining ingredients, and whisk to incorporate.

recipe:korean-marinated-eggs:step:2.en: Pop the eggs into the marinade so they are covered and place a paper towel over the top. This will make sure the marinade is evenly distributed.

recipe:korean-marinated-eggs:step:3.en: Pop them in the fridge overnight, or for up to 4 days. Serve with freshly cooked rice.

recipe:korean-marinated-eggs:ingredient:.pt: 3 colheres de sopa de Vinagre de Arroz
2 colheres de sopa de Molho de Peixe

recipe:green-peanut-aubergine-noodles:st.en: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the aubergine into batons, transfer to a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil before seasoning with salt and pepper. Cook in the oven for 20-25 mins until charred.

Meanwhile, put the tahini into a blender with the juice of both limes, miso paste, soy sauce, just a splash of water and a handful of ice cubes. Blitz until smooth, then add the coriander and remaining water. Blitz again until combined, then check and adjust the seasoning if needed.
When you’re ready to eat, cook the noodles following pack instructions, then drain and rinse in cold water to stop the cooking process. Toss the noodles in the sesame oil and set aside.
Halve the tomatoes. Finely slice the spring onions. Crush the peanuts.
Share the coriander broth between serving bowls, then top with the noodles, peanuts, aubergine batons, chilli oil and spring onions. Give it a good mix and get stuck in.

recipe:green-peanut-aubergine-noodles:in.pt: 1 colher de sopa de Pasta de Miso
4 colheres de sopa de Molho de Soja
4 colheres de sopa de Óleo de Malagueta

recipe:biscoff-baked-oats:step:0.en: Heat the oven to 175°C. Combine the oats, banana, egg whites, milk, protein powder, baking powder, cinnamon and a pinch of salt in a blender, then blend until smooth.

recipe:biscoff-baked-oats:step:1.en: Spray a baking dish with oil spray or rub with coconut/other oil, then pour in the mixture.

recipe:biscoff-baked-oats:step:2.en: Melt 1 tsp Biscoff spread for 10-15 seconds in the microwave and pour it in the dish. Swirl it around into the batter with a skewer, toothpick or the tip of a knife.

recipe:biscoff-baked-oats:step:3.en: Add another 1 tsp spread (not melted) into the centre of the mixture, smoothing the oats over the top so it’s in the middle of the mixture. Bake for 15-20 mins, or until you can insert the skewer and have it come out clean.

recipe:biscoff-baked-oats:step:4.en: Melt another 1 tsp Biscoff spread and drizzle on top, followed by half a Lotus biscuit.

recipe:blt-chicken-salad-meal-prep:step:.en: Butterfly the chicken breasts and season them generously with salt and pepper.
Add the bacon to a frying pan and place over a medium heat. Cook for 4–5 mins, until crispy and golden on both sides. Transfer to a plate, keeping the fat in the pan.
Add the chicken breasts to the same pan. Cook for 10–15 mins, flipping occasionally, until golden and cooked through.

Meanwhile, pick the parsley leaves and discard the stems. Chop the tomatoes (for the salad) into bite-sized chunks. Remove any tough kale stalks and add the leaves to a large bowl. Season with salt and massage for a couple of minutes until soft and wilted.

Make the dressing. Halve the tomato and coarsely grate the cut side into a bowl, discarding the skins. Crumble in half of the cooked bacon. Stir through the olive oil and season with salt, black pepper and a splash of sherry vinegar, to taste.
Add the parsley, chopped tomatoes, quinoa and tomato dressing to the bowl of kale. Toss everything together until well combined.

Slice the cooked chicken breasts. Share the salad between Tupperware containers and top with the chicken. Finish with the remaining crumbled bacon and a generous crack of black pepper. Once cooled, box up and pop in the fridge, ready for tomorrow’s lunch — they’ll keep for up to 3 days.

recipe:spicy-chorizo-pepper-stew:step:0.en: Finely chop the red onions and thinly slice ¾ of the garlic cloves. Cut the chorizo into chunky coins and the jarred grilled red peppers into strips about 1-2 cm wide.

recipe:spicy-chorizo-pepper-stew:step:1.en: Preheat a large saucepan over a medium-high heat and add a good glug of olive oil. Add the chorizo and cook for 3-4 mins, or until rendered and beginning to crisp up a little. Add the onions and cook for 4-5 mins with a pinch of salt before dropping in the sliced garlic.

recipe:spicy-chorizo-pepper-stew:step:2.en: Cook together for one more minute before tipping in the butter beans, the liquid from their tins, the tinned tomatoes and the jarred peppers. Season with salt and a little pepper. Cook together for 20 mins or so until slightly reduced.

recipe:spicy-chorizo-pepper-stew:step:3.en: Finely chop the parsley and tip into a bowl with the zest and juice of the lemons. Mix with a little olive oil.

recipe:spicy-chorizo-pepper-stew:step:4.en: Finely grate the remaining garlic clove into a bowl with the mayonnaise and mix thoroughly.

recipe:spicy-chorizo-pepper-stew:step:5.en: Divide the stew between warm bowls and top with a few spoons of the gremolata parsley dressing. Finish with a dollop of garlicky mayo and serve. Throw on an extra lemon wedge if you like.

recipe:sun-dried-tomato-cottage-cheese-c.en: Place a saucepan of water to the boil. Once boiling, gently drop the eggs in and cook for 6 mins, until jammy.

Meanwhile, pick the herb leaves, discarding the stalks. Trim and thinly slice the onion, place into a sieve and wash until cold running water until crispy. Add all three to a bowl, toss with the sumac and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl, swirl the pesto through. Top with the boiled egg and garnish with the onion salad. Enjoy with bread.

recipe:sweet-sticky-chicken-with-broccol.en: Sweet & Sticky Chicken with Broccoli Rice
Finely slice the garlic and roughly chop the broccoli.
Add the butter to a large saucepan set over a medium heat. Once melted, add the garlic and cook for 2 mins, stirring regularly until softened. Add the chopped broccoli and cook for another 2–3 mins.

Wash the rice and stir it through the broccoli mix. Pour in the water and bring to the boil. Pop a lid on, reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 10 mins to finish steaming.
Meanwhile, mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sriracha and honey in a small bowl.

Slice the chicken thighs into bite-sized chunks — about 5–6 pieces per thigh. Set a large frying pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in a single layer (you may need to work in batches to avoid overcrowding). Season with salt and cook for 6 mins until golden and crispy on one side. Flip and cook for another 2–3 mins until cooked through.
Take the pan off the heat and pour in the sauce. Toss to coat the chicken in the glaze. If the sauce looks too runny, return to the heat for 1–2 mins to thicken slightly.

Thinly slice the spring onions. Spoon the broccoli rice into bowls or containers, top with the sticky chicken and any sauce left in the pan. Finish with spring onions, sesame seeds and a wedge of lemon.

recipe:sweet-sticky-chicken-with-broccol.pt: 400g Coxas de Frango sem Pele e sem Osso
2 c. sopa de Molho de Ostra
1 c. sopa de Molho de Soja
1 c. sopa de Vinagre de Arroz

recipe:herby-chicken-caesar-schnitzel:st.en: Lay out a piece of baking parchment or cling film on your work surface. Put 1 chicken breast on top, cover with another piece of baking parchment or cling film and then bash the chicken with a rolling pin until it’s around 3mm thick. Repeat with the remaining chicken breasts.

Tip the plain flour onto a baking tray and season with salt and pepper. Crack the eggs onto another tray and whisk, then season with salt and pepper. Finally, tip the breadcrumbs onto another tray and season them, too.
Dip the chicken breasts one at a time into the flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs so that they are totally coated. Pop them in the fridge until you are ready to fry.

Add around 1cm oil to a large frying pan, then bring it up to temperature over a medium heat. It needs to be around 170°C. Carefully pop the chicken breasts into the pan, two at a time, and fry for about 3 mins each side, basting as they cook, until the chicken is crisp and golden. Remove from the pan and drain on a rack lined with kitchen paper.

For the salad, slice the romaine, then finely slice the cornichons and jalapeño (remove the seeds if it’s particularly spicy). Transfer everything to a large bowl. Chop the parsley and add to the bowl, then finely chop the chives and set them aside.
Put the mayo, anchovies, garlic and the juice of the lemon into a blender. Blitz until smooth, then season with salt and a generous grinding of black pepper.
When you’re ready to serve, toss the salad with the dressing. Serve the schnitzel on plates, top with the salad, then finish with a good grating of Parmesan and the chives.

recipe:lazy-cottage-cheese-tomato-pasta:.en: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta according to packet instructions until al dente. Reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.

Meanwhile, pour the tomato sauce into a frying pan and warm over a medium heat for 2–3 mins until bubbling. Add the cottage cheese and stir it through the sauce until it melts and turns creamy, adding a splash of pasta water if it's looking too thick. Toss in the spinach and let it wilt for 1–2 mins. Season with salt and plenty of black pepper.

Add the drained pasta to the pan and toss until evenly coated in the sauce, adding a little more pasta water to loosen if needed. Grate in most of the Parmesan and tear in most of the basil, stirring through.
Serve topped with the remaining Parmesan and basil.

recipe:lazy-cottage-cheese-tomato-pasta:.pt: 1 Frasco de 350g de Molho de Tomate para Massa

recipe:10-minute-smoky-harissa-creamy-bu.en: Add the cherry tomatoes to a pan with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt. Set it over a medium-high heat and cook for about 5 mins until starting to soften and burst open. Add a splash of water if they’re catching on the bottom of the pan.
Mince the garlic and add it to the tomatoes in the pan along with the tomato paste, ¾ of the harissa and the smoked paprika.

Add the tinned butterbeans and ½ their liquid to the pan then stir in the vegan cream cheese. Bring the mixture to a boil then turn down the heat and simmer for 5-10 mins until the beans have softened and the broth has thickened (it should be creamy).
Meanwhile, toast the bread and finely chop the herbs.
To serve, ladle the beans into bowls. Drizzle over the tahini and some remaining harissa. Finish with the chopped herbs, flaked almonds and the toast on the side.

recipe:peanut-sriracha-noodles:step:0.en: Get a pan of salted water to the boil. Meanwhile, very finely slice the sugar snaps into long pieces. Toss in a bowl with half the lime juice. Roughly chop the peanuts, if using.

recipe:peanut-sriracha-noodles:step:1.en: In a separate large bowl stir together the peanut butter, Sriracha, soy and remaining lime juice or rice wine vinegar to make your sauce.

recipe:peanut-sriracha-noodles:step:2.en: Unravel the noodles with your fingers into the pan of salted boiling water and cook for 1 min then, using tongs, transfer the noodles straight into the sauce. Toss together, adding a splash of the cooking water to create a silky, luscious sauce.

recipe:peanut-sriracha-noodles:step:3.en: Divide between bowls and top with the shredded sugar snaps, salted peanuts (if using) and more sriracha and soy, if you like. Boom.

recipe:peanut-sriracha-noodles:ingredien.pt: 3 colheres de sopa de Manteiga de Amendoim Lisa
1 colher de sopa de Molho de Soja

recipe:honey-zaatar-halloumi-herby-pomeg.en: Honey Za’atar Halloumi, Herby Pomegranate Slaw & Hummus
Slice the cabbage in half lengthways and finely shred. Thinly slice the red onion. Roughly chop three-quarters of the dill. Add everything to a large bowl.

Drizzle over the pomegranate molasses, squeeze in the juice of half a lemon, and add the olive oil. Season with salt and pepper, then mix well to combine. Let the slaw sit and lightly pickle while you cook the halloumi.

Cut the halloumi into 2cm cubes. Set a frying pan over medium-high heat (no oil needed). Fry the halloumi cubes for 1–2 mins on each side until golden and crisp. Drizzle in the honey and sprinkle over the za’atar. Cook for 30 seconds, tossing to coat, then take off the heat.
Divide the hummus between two containers or plates. Spoon over the herby slaw, top with the sticky halloumi and finish with the remaining dill.

recipe:honey-zaatar-halloumi-herby-pomeg.pt: 2 colheres de sopa de Melaço de Romã
2 colheres de sopa de Azeite Extra Virgem

recipe:blueberry-crunch-overnight-oats:s.en: Roughly chop the nuts and place them into a dry frying pan. Place onto medium heat and toast, stirring often, until golden, 5-8 mins. Tip half into a bowl and stir the honey and the rest of the topping ingredients through. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.
In the empty pan, make the base: Tip in the frozen blueberries and honey on medium heat and stir until the blueberries have defrosted. Remove from the heat and let it cool down.

Add the oats and remaining frozen blueberries into the bowl with the nuts. Coarsely grate the apple into the mixture and stir through the lemon zest, milk, and yoghurt. Season with as much honey as you’d like, and a pinch of salt
Share the blueberry coulis into jars and ladle the oat mixture on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight so the oats can soften. Once ready to eat, serve the blueberry pots with the toasted nuts.

recipe:harrisa-and-mackerel-rigatoni:ste.en: Bring a large saucepan of well-salted water to the boil. Add the rigatoni and cook for 2 mins less than the pack instructions.
Meanwhile, finely chop most of the parsley and set aside, save the remaining leaves to serve.
Thinly slice the garlic. Place a frying pan over a medium heat with the olive oil. Add the garlic and cook for about 1 min until softened but not coloured.

Stir in the harissa paste and cook for 1 min more. Tip in the cherry tomatoes whole, then prick each one with a knife so the skins split. Use the back of a spoon or a potato masher to squash them slightly as they cook.
Add the mackerel, breaking it up gently with a spoon. Season well with salt and black pepper, then cook for 2 mins until everything is warmed through and saucy.

Using a slotted spoon, transfer the rigatoni straight into the sauce and toss well to coat, add in a big splash of pasta water. Squeeze in the juice from half of the lemon and stir in the chopped parsley. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Spoon into bowls, scatter over the remaining parsley and serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges on the side.

recipe:harrisa-and-mackerel-rigatoni:ing.pt: 2 colheres de sopa de Pasta de Harissa

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:0.en: Put a large pan of well-salted water onto the boil (it should taste pleasantly salty). Cut the florets off the broccoli and halve the larger ones – you can leave the small ones whole.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:1.en: Peel and discard the tough skin from the broccoli stalk and then cut the remaining stalk into strips about 1cm thick. Cut the strips in half lengthways and widthways so you have roughly thumb-sized rectangles.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:2.en: Once the water is boiling, tip in the broccoli florets and stalk pieces and let them cook for about 5 mins until quite tender – you should be able to skewer them on a fork easily.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:3.en: Meanwhile, put a large frying pan with nice high sides over a low-medium heat and add the olive oil. Roughly chop the olives. Now you’ve got two choices: either slightly crush the garlic but leave it whole to be removed later (milder), or chop the garlic and add the whole lot (stronger). Either way, add the garlic to the oil along with the olives, chilli and anchovies, if using.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:4.en: Let the garlic cook gently for a couple of minutes, but don't let it go brown. The anchovies will dissolve into the oil and by now your broccoli should be ready, so use a slotted spoon to scoop it out of the water and put it straight into the pan with the garlic, making sure you get a good splash of the water in there as well.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:5.en: Add the pasta to the broccoli water and cook until al dente. Meanwhile, mash the broccoli with the back of a wooden spoon to create a creamy sauce with the oil and water. Squeeze in the lemon juice and then turn the heat off until the pasta is cooked.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:6.en: Once al dente, add the pasta to the pan with the broccoli plus a splash of pasta water. Mix well over a medium heat until the pasta is saucy and well coated. Taste and add more salt if needed.

recipe:rigatoni-with-broccoli:step:7.en: Plate up and finish with a drizzle of olive oil, pepper and an extra pinch of chilli, if you like.

recipe:mujadara:step:0.en: Finely slice the shallot, then separate the layers. Pour the olive oil into a small frying pan and place onto medium heat. Add the shallot then simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10-15 mins until the shallots turn golden. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the shallots to a plate lined with kitchen paper.

recipe:mujadara:step:1.en: Meanwhile, pick the parsley leaves and finely slice the stalks. Stir the nigella seeds into the yoghurt and season with salt and the juice of half a lemon. Set aside.

recipe:mujadara:step:2.en: Add the cumin seeds and parsley stalks to the hot shallot oil and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Tip the rice and lentils in, stirring to thoroughly mix. Cook until piping hot, 2-3 mins. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Stir half the shallots through, remove from the heat and cover with a lid.

recipe:mujadara:step:3.en: Slice the remaining lemon half into wedges. Toss the parsley leaves through the mujadara and share between bowls. Enjoy with nigella seed yoghurt, your remaining shallots, and a lemon wedge.

recipe:mujadara:ingredient:3.pt: 2 colheres de chá de Sementes de Nigela

recipe:mujadara:ingredient:6.pt: 1 colher de chá de Sementes de Cominhos

recipe:chicken-pepper-cucumber-chopped-s.en: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Season your chicken breasts generously with salt and pepper. Place your breasts onto a baking tray and get them in the oven for 25 mins. Allow them to cool once cooked – the salad doesn’t need to be warm.
Chop up the basil, the roasted red peppers, cucumbers, pistachios, and chicken into even-sized pieces. Combine in a bowl before topping with kalamata olives and the dressing. Toss vigorously.
Serve with a dollop of cottage cheese on each portion and enjoy.

recipe:pork-belly-benedict-with-gochujan.en: Pork Belly Benedict With Gochujang Hollandaise
Ribbon the cucumber and apple and finely slice your green chilli.
Add the above to a pickle of rice vinegar, water, salt and sugar.
Create the marinade by mixing teriyaki, dark soy, lime and rice vinegar.
Marinate pork belly (in strips) before adding to a covered dish and roast for 45 mins at 180°C.
Remove the cover from the dish and further cook for 45 mins until dark and crispy.
To make the hollandaise, vigorously whisk the egg yolks and rice vinegar until frothy.
In a separate pan, slowly melt butter and gochujang together until warm.
Gradually pour the melted butter mix into the egg yolks and continue to whisk. Once mixed, set aside. You can slowly reheat later if needed.
Poach the eggs until almost done and set aside, allowing to cook through.
Toast the crumpet and bring everything together.
Top the Benedict with sesame seeds (we like a mixture of white and black) and long slices of spring onion.

recipe:pork-belly-benedict-with-gochujan.pt: 2 colheres de sopa de Molho Teriyaki
1 colher de sopa de Molho de Soja Escuro
1 colher de sopa de Sumo de Lima
1 colher de chá de Vinagre de Arroz
2 colheres de chá de Vinagre de Arroz
1 colher de sopa de Sumo de Lima

recipe:creamy-spicy-pork-ramen:step:0.en: Bring a saucepan filled with water to the boil. Once boiling add the spinach leaves and blanch for 30 seconds, stirring regularly. Remove the spinach and transfer to a bowl of ice cold water. Set aside.

recipe:creamy-spicy-pork-ramen:step:1.en: To the same pan of water, add the beansprouts and blanch for 2 mins. Remove and set aside. Turn the heat off and set the pan and water aside to cook the noodles in later.

recipe:creamy-spicy-pork-ramen:step:2.en: For the pork mince: finely mince the garlic clove and spring onion, separating the whites and greens. Heat a glug of sesame oil in a saucepan over a high heat for about a minute. Add the pork mince and fry for about 3 mins until browned, breaking the mince into small pieces with a spoon as you go. Add the doubanjiang, light soy sauce, white sugar, MSG, minced garlic, the spring onion whites and a pinch of salt and black pepper. Fry for a further 1-2 mins. Transfer everything to a bowl and set aside.

recipe:creamy-spicy-pork-ramen:step:3.en: For the broth: to the same pan, add the chicken stock, oat milk, light soy sauce, mirin, MSG and a pinch of salt and black pepper. Bring to a boil over a high heat with the lid off. Simmer for 5 mins or until reduced by a quarter. Add the chilli oil and reduce the heat to lowest, set aside while we cook the noodles. Season to taste (it should be slightly overly salty).

recipe:creamy-spicy-pork-ramen:step:4.en: Bring the pot of water used to cook the spinach back to a boil. Once boiling, cook the noodles a minute shy of the pack instructions, then drain and divide between bowls.

recipe:creamy-spicy-pork-ramen:step:5.en: Ladle the broth over the noodles so they’re submerged. Add a handful of beansprouts and top them with a large spoonful of pork mince, then serve some spinach and the spring onion greens on the side.

recipe:carrot-cake-bircher-muesli:step:0.en: Finely chop the walnuts and pecans, finely zest the orange, and coarsely grate the carrots. Add them into a bowl with the chia seeds, oats and hemp seeds.

recipe:carrot-cake-bircher-muesli:step:1.en: In a jug, whisk together the water and yoghurt until smooth, then stir in the juice of the orange. Season with a pinch of salt and honey to taste.

recipe:carrot-cake-bircher-muesli:step:2.en: Pour the liquid mixture into the dry ingredients and mix well. Divide between jars or containers, cover, and chill for at least 4 hours or overnight, until the oats and chia have soaked up the liquid.

recipe:carrot-cake-bircher-muesli:step:3.en: To make the seed topping, toast the mixed seeds and sesame seeds in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 3–4 mins, or until golden and popping. Remove from the heat and stir in the mixed spice, a touch of salt, and honey. Spread onto a plate to cool, then store in an airtight container at room temperature.

recipe:carrot-cake-bircher-muesli:step:4.en: When ready to serve, top each portion of muesli with a dollop of Greek yoghurt and a generous sprinkle of spiced seed crunch.

recipe:probiotic-bircher-muesli:step:0.en: Grate the apple into a large bowl before mixing in the remaining ingredients.

recipe:probiotic-bircher-muesli:step:1.en: Cover and place in the fridge for at least a couple of hours and ideally overnight.

recipe:probiotic-bircher-muesli:step:2.en: To serve, sprinkle over any nuts or seeds you like. Enjoy!

recipe:morning-milk-tea-chia-pudding:ste.en: Pour the water, salt and milk into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the teabags then remove the pan from the heat and let the tea steep for 4-5 mins, until you have a dark brew.
Strain the tea mixture into a bowl or box and season to taste with maple syrup. Then, stir through the chia, oats and hemp seeds. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 5 hours, ideally overnight.

Meanwhile, make the cinnamon nuts: Roughly chop the pecans. Heat the oil in a large frying pan set over a medium heat. Once hot, add the pecans, sunflower seeds and flaked almonds and cook, stirring, until toasted and golden. Remove from the heat and stir through the cinnamon, salt and maple syrup. Transfer to a jar or box and cover with a lid. Place in the fridge until ready to use.
To serve, spoon the oat mixture into bowls (mix through a splash of milk if it's thickened too much). Serve with a dollop of Greek yoghurt, and top with the maple cinnamon nut mix.

recipe:morning-milk-tea-chia-pudding:ing.pt: 6 Saquetas de Chá Inglês de Pequeno-Almoço
0,25 colher de chá de Flor de Sal
2 colheres de chá de Canela em Pó
0,25 colher de chá de Flor de Sal

recipe:spanakopita-breakfast-wraps:step:.en: Heat your oven to 180°C fan. Blitz the cottage cheese in a blender until smooth. Crack all the eggs (but one) into a large bowl and whisk well. Fold through the blended cottage cheese and season generously with salt and pepper.
Separate the last egg – whisk the white and set aside for later. Add the yolk into the egg mixture.

Line a large baking tray with parchment paper. Pour in the egg mixture and bake for 15 mins until puffed and golden. Turn the tray around and bake for another 5 mins for even cooking. Let it cool slightly if serving straight away, or completely if prepping ahead.
While the egg’s in the oven, peel and finely dice the onions, and peel and finely chop the garlic. Finely chop the dill and mint. Zest the lemon and set aside.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and garlic, season with a pinch of salt, and cook for 10 mins until soft and just golden.

Place a large colander over the sink. Add the spinach in batches and pour over boiling water to wilt. Once cool enough to handle, squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Roughly chop the wilted spinach and set aside.
Add the spinach to the pan with the softened onion and garlic. Stir through the dill, mint, lemon zest and crumbled feta. Season generously – the feta can handle it!

Cut the baked egg sheet into even rectangles. Warm the tortilla wraps in a dry pan or microwave until soft. Place an egg slice in the centre of each wrap, top with the spinach-feta filling, fold in the sides, then roll up tightly like a burrito.

Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat. Place each wrap seam-side down and cook for 2–3 mins to seal. Brush the tops with the reserved egg white, sprinkle over sesame seeds, then air fry at 200°C for 5 mins until golden and crisp.
Remove any foil, wrap in damp kitchen paper and microwave for 2 mins. Finish in the air fryer at 180°C for 7–8 mins (or in the oven at 160°C for 10 mins) until piping hot.

To Meal Prep: Assemble and seal the wraps, then store in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 4 days. Reheat as above.To Freeze: Once cooled, wrap each wrap tightly in foil or cling film. Freeze for up to 2 months. Defrost overnight in the fridge before reheating.

recipe:anchovy-butter-spaghetti-recipe:s.en: Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil.
Whisk the egg yolk in a bowl with a big crack of black pepper. Finely grate the Parmesan and add to the egg mixture. Set aside. Finely chop the parsley and set aside.
Drop the pasta into the boiling water and set a timer for 1 min less than pack instructions.

Meanwhile, place a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the butter and, once melted and frothy, add all the anchovies, along with the oil from the tins. 
Sizzle for 2 mins, using a spatula or wooden spoon to break the anchovies up into a paste. Use a microplane or garlic crusher to grate or crush the garlic straight into the pan. Sizzle for 1 min, then remove from the heat and wait for the pasta timer to go off.

If moved off the heat, place the frying pan back over the heat. Use tongs to transfer the cooked pasta to the pan and toss with the sauce. Add a ladle of pasta water and keep tossing until the pasta is silky, then remove from the heat.

Add the egg and Parmesan mix and toss well, adding a splash of water if you need to loosen further. The sauce should be clinging to the pasta. Add the parsley and slowly squeeze in the juice of the lemon until it's seasoned to your liking. Toss further, then tip onto plates and finish with an extra grating of Parmesan and a crack of black pepper.

recipe:high-protein-breakfast-burritos:s.en: Chop the potatoes into small chunks around 1-2cm wide. Microwave for 3-4 mins to soften, then spray with some low-calorie spray and season with ½ tsp onion powder, ½ tsp paprika, salt and pepper. Air fry at 180°C for 10-15 mins, or until crispy.

Meanwhile, tip the mince and the remaining onion powder and paprika into a frying pan set over a medium-high heat. Break the mince up as it cooks and add the Worcestershire sauce and tomato purée. Cook for around 5 mins, then set the mince aside and wipe the pan so it’s mostly clean.

Whisk the egg and egg whites together, plus some salt and pepper, then add the Flora/butter to the frying pan over a low heat until it starts to melt. Pour in the eggs and leave them to set for around 10 seconds at a time before folding them over. Repeat for a couple of mins until they’re almost at your desired consistency, then remove from the heat. They will continue to cook a little once removed from the heat, so be careful not to overdo them.

Now it’s time to assemble your burrito! Heat the wrap to make it flexible, then spread ½ tbsp chilli jam onto the centre of each wrap, followed by the potatoes and the egg. Chop the chives and sprinkle over the egg, then add the pork mince, the mozzarella, and finally another drizzle of the remaining chilli jam. Fold either side in and then roll it up, tucking it under as you go so it holds together nicely.
Wipe the pan clean from the egg, then reheat it to a medium heat and pop the wrap in (flap-side down to hold it together). Cook for a couple of minutes each side until browned.
Leave to cool for 5 mins, then cut in half and enjoy!

recipe:high-protein-breakfast-burritos:i.pt: 2 colheres de chá de Cebola em Pó
1 colher de chá de Molho Worcestershire
1 colher de chá de Concentrado de Tomate
3 colheres de sopa de Claras de Ovo
1 colher de sopa de Compota de Malagueta

recipe:spicy-pork-rice-bowl-with-sesame-.en: Spicy Pork Rice Bowl with Sesame Broccoli
Finely grate the garlic and mix it with the gochujang, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar in a small bowl. Set aside.
Place a large frying pan over a high heat with the vegetable oil. Once hot, add the pork mince and cook for 5–7 mins, breaking it up with a spoon as you go, until golden and caramelised.
Pour in the sauce and stir through. Cook for another 2–3 mins until thick, glossy and sticky.
Meanwhile, microwave the tenderstem broccoli for 2 mins until just tender. Toss with a pinch of salt, the sesame oil and the sesame seeds. Alternatively, steam or pan-fry if you prefer.
Trim and thinly slice the spring onions.
Spoon the rice into containers. Top with the pork, sesame broccoli and a scattering of spring onions and extra sesame seeds. Leave to cool and pop in the fridge until needed.

recipe:crispy-chicken-brown-rice-chickpe.en: Crispy Chicken, Brown Rice, Chickpeas & Tzatziki

Place the chicken thighs skin-side down on a chopping board. Run a knife along each side of the bone to expose it. Using scissors, cut underneath the bone to remove it. Repeat with the remaining chicken thighs. Once the're all prepped, season with salt and pepper.
Cut the courgette in half lengthways and then into half moons. Cut the red onion into large chunks.
Add the chicken, skin side down into a cold, large frying pan and set it over a medium heat. Cook for 10-15 mins until the chicken skin is golden brown.

While the chicken is cooking, make the tzatziki. Grate the cucumber into a bowl and season with salt. Set aside for 5 mins then squeeze out the excess water. Add the squeezed cucumber to the yoghurt with the zest of the lemon and the juice of ½ the lemon. Grate in the garlic. Mix well to combine then season to taste with salt. Set aside.
When the chicken skin is golden brown and crispy, flip the chicken thighs and cook for a further 2 mins. Remove them from the pan and set aside.

Add the red onion, courgette and spices to the pan. Grate in the garlic then cook over a medium heat until soft. (If anything catches on the bottom of the pan, just add a little water and scrape it up). Add the drained chickpeas and cooked rice to the pan. Cook over a medium heat for 2-3 mins until everything has come together. Season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, pick the parsley leaves and cut the chicken into thick slices.
To serve, divide the rice between plates then top with the chicken and tzatziki. Sprinkle over the parsley and finish with a lemon wedge.

recipe:crispy-chicken-brown-rice-chickpe.pt: 4 Coxas de Frango com Osso e com Pele

recipe:spanakopita-orzo-2:step:0.en: Heat the oven to 160°C. Tip the pine nuts onto a baking tray and roast for 10-12 mins until golden.

recipe:spanakopita-orzo-2:step:1.en: Finely slice the onion and chop the garlic. Heat a splash of oil in the biggest pot you have, then add the onion and fry for 10 mins over a medium heat. Add the garlic, cook for another 2 mins and pour in the wine, cooking off until evaporated.

recipe:spanakopita-orzo-2:step:2.en: Add a big handful of spinach and rocket – it will take a few goes to get it all wilted down. Keep wilting and adding the leaves until it’s all used up, then remove the mixture from the pan and set aside to cool.

recipe:spanakopita-orzo-2:step:3.en: Tip the orzo into the pan along with the vegetable stock. Give it a mix once its added to the pot to prevent sticking, bring it up to a simmer, cover with a lid and cook for 10 mins until the liquid has been absorbed.

recipe:spanakopita-orzo-2:step:4.en: Meanwhile, squeeze as much of the liquid out of the spinach mix as you can, then finely chop. Finely chop the dill and mix most of it through the orzo, along with the chopped spinach. Grate in the zest of the lemon with a squeeze of the juice, then season with salt and pepper.

recipe:spanakopita-orzo-2:step:5.en: Spoon out the orzo into your Tupperware containers. Once cool, top with crumbled feta, the pine nuts and the remaining dill.Box up and pop in the fridge - they'll last for up to 3 days.

recipe:cheesy-okonomiyaki-recipe:step:0.en: Combine the wet batter ingredients in a small bowl, stir until thick and paste-like, almost like thick greek yoghurt, set aside in the fridge. Slice the cheddar and mozzarella and grate the Parmesan. Cheese is optional if you want to keep this dairy-free!

recipe:cheesy-okonomiyaki-recipe:step:1.en: Very finely slice the cabbage, shiitake mushrooms, and spring onions, (reserving the green part for garnish later). Into a large bowl, add minced ginger, eggs, sesame oil, soy sauce and salt, whisk vigorously for 1 minute, or until the eggs get slightly frothy and small bubbles appear. Fold the cabbage, mushrooms and spring onion whites until combined, then mix in the prepared wet batter. If the vegetables aren’t coated in the batter, add a tablespoon of water into the batter until coated - make sure to not add too much water, the batter shouldn’t be loose.

recipe:cheesy-okonomiyaki-recipe:step:2.en: Heat a 6-inch frying pan over medium heat and add 1 tbsp neutral oil and swirl around the pan, making sure to get all the edges of the pan. Add 1/4 of the batter, and use a spatula to spread across the pan, but do not flatten the pancake, keep it airy! Turn the heat to low, add a few slices of cheddar and mozzarella, lightly pressing them into the batter, then cover the cheese with a little bit more batter. Place a lid on and cook for 2 mins, or until the bottom of the pancake looks golden brown (keep the bowl of remaining batter in the fridge).

recipe:cheesy-okonomiyaki-recipe:step:3.en: Slide the pancake onto a large plate, with the raw side facing up, then flip the pan over the plate, and flip back into the pan. Drizzle a tsp of oil around the edge of the pan and cook for 4 mins without a lid, or until golden brown. In the meantime, fry your eggs in another pan and set aside. Flip the pancake again, and cook on medium heat for just 1 minute to crisp up the other side. (eat this pancake now or cook the second pancake.)

recipe:cheesy-okonomiyaki-recipe:step:4.en: In the same pan, add another drizzle of oil and fry the remaining eggs to serve on top of your pancake.

recipe:cheesy-okonomiyaki-recipe:step:5.en: Pop up the onto pancake a plate, crispy side up. To garnish the okonomiyaki, sprinkle over a thin layer of grated Parmesan and drizzle HP sauce in long lines across the pancake, then repeat with the mayo. Top with the fried egg, spring onion, toasted sesame seeds.

recipe:smashed-prawn-tacos:step:0.en: Preheat the grill to high. Add the prawns, chipotle, sundried tomatoes, cumin and fish sauce into a food processor. Blitz until the prawns break down into a paste. If you don’t have a food processor, finely mince everything by hand until paste-like.

recipe:smashed-prawn-tacos:step:1.en: Pick half the coriander leaves and mince the rest. Using a vegetable peeler, thinly shave the cabbage, toss with the juice of ½ a lime, then season with salt. Thinly slice the avocados.

recipe:smashed-prawn-tacos:step:2.en: Add the cherry tomatoes to a baking tray and place under the grill for 5-10 mins until they blister and char. Transfer to a bowl and mash whilst still hot. Let them cool down and season with salt and the juice of 1 lime. Before serving, fold the minced coriander through.

recipe:smashed-prawn-tacos:step:3.en: Divide the prawn filling between the tortillas (around 1 heaped tbsp each) and spread into one even layer, all the way to the edges. Place a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. Once hot, cook the tacos, prawn-side down, for 2-3 mins until cooked through, then flip and cook the tortilla until charred in spots. Transfer to a plate and cover. Continue until all of them are cooked.

recipe:smashed-prawn-tacos:step:4.en: Top the tacos with cabbage, avocado, burnt tomato salsa and the remaining coriander. Serve with any remaining lime wedges.

recipe:kedgeree:step:0.en: Put the eggs into a small pan filled with boiling water and cook for 7 mins. Drain and run under cold water, then peel and set aside.

recipe:kedgeree:step:1.en: Get the smoked haddock in a deep frying pan and pour over 750ml of cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently for 5 mins. Use a slotted spoon to scoop the fish out onto a plate, then break into bite-sized pieces.

recipe:kedgeree:step:2.en: Wash the rice until the water runs clear then tip into a saucepan and measure in 500ml of the fish poaching liquid. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat to a very gentle simmer, put on a lid and cook for 10 mins until all of the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from the heat and keep the lid on while you prepare the rest.

recipe:kedgeree:step:3.en: Finely chop the onion, garlic and ginger. Put the butter into a deep frying pan over a medium-high heat and scrape in the onion, garlic and ginger and a pinch of salt. Cook gently for 8-10 mins, stirring regularly, until softened, then add the curry powder. Cook for a minute then tip in the peas, flaked fish and cooked rice. Roughly chop the coriander and thinly slice the green chilli.

recipe:kedgeree:step:4.en: Add ¾ of the coriander, the juice of the lemon and plenty of salt and pepper, then stir to combine.

recipe:kedgeree:step:5.en: Divide between 4 plates and top with the remaining coriander leaves, crispy onions and mango chutney and lime pickle on the side. Cut the eggs in half and top each plate with a half.

recipe:kedgeree:ingredient:7.pt: 2 colheres de sopa de Caril em Pó

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:0.en: If you don’t have roasted peanuts, heat the oven to 160°C. Tip the peanuts onto a baking tray and roast in the oven for 15-20 mins, or until lightly golden, then remove and set aside. Don’t roast them too brown, as they will continue to brown out of the oven.

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:1.en: Fill a medium pot with water and season like you would pasta water. Add the baby potatoes and bring to the boil.

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:2.en: Meanwhile, slice the tempeh into 1cm-thick pieces, then into matchsticks. Now slice the tofu into 2cm pieces and cut into squares. Finely mince the garlic clove and set aside. Add a shot of oil to a large pan with a good pinch of salt, add all the tofu and tempeh and toss to coat every piece. Cook on each side for 2 mins, or until lightly golden, then add the minced garlic, toss to coat, and cook for 1 min. Add the maple syrup and toss for 30 seconds, then set aside in a small bowl.

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:3.en: Add the eggs to the boiling water and cook for 7 mins. Remove the potatoes when fork-tender and transfer to a large plate. Remove the eggs into a bowl of cold tap water and lightly crack the shell to soak, then set aside (this helps it peel easier). When the potatoes and egg are removed, add the beansprouts, cook for 2 mins, then remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to the plate. Cut the ends off the green beans, then half them and boil for 2 mins. Remove onto the plate. Now cook the spinach for just 30 seconds, then press against the pot to squeeze out some excess water before adding to the plate.

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:4.en: Slice all the cherry tomatoes into halves and set aside on another large plate. Slice the iceberg into ¼ wedges, finely slice the cucumber into slices, slice the potato into ¼ pieces, slice the lime wedges and then peel the eggs, by cracking the shell all over and peeling under the water, then cut in half, and place everything onto the same large plate.

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:5.en: Combine all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.

recipe:gado-gado-salad-bowl:step:6.en: To serve, place one layer of iceberg leaves on the base of your serving plates, creating a flower pattern. Squeeze out all the excess water from the spinach and place into a pile on the edge of the plate, then following a circular pattern add a handful of beansprouts, green beans, crispy tofu, tempeh, cherry tomatoes, eggs and cucumber, but leave a gap in the middle for the dressing. Add half the dressing into the centre, then add a heap of sweetcorn on the side. Garnish with roasted peanuts and crispy shallots over the dressing, and serve with a wedge of lime.

recipe:rolled-eggs-breakfast-wrap:step:1.en: Thinly slice the mushrooms, cut each of the onions into eight wedges and place onto an oiled baking tray (you may need two trays). Season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, and cumin. Toss together and roast until golden and softened, 25-30 mins.

recipe:rolled-eggs-breakfast-wrap:step:2.en: Meanwhile, crack the eggs into a bowl and season them with salt and garam masala. Whisk together. Pour boiling water over the spinach to wilt. Once cooled down a little, press down to squeeze out any excess water.

recipe:rolled-eggs-breakfast-wrap:step:3.en: Place a frying pan, roughly the size of your tortillas onto medium heat with a drizzle of oil. One hot, add just enough whisked eggs to cover the bottom of your pan, swirl around and let the bottom set. When the top of the omelette is still wet, place the tortilla on top, then flip. Toast the tortilla for a couple of seconds, then transfer to a plate. Continue this process until all the tortillas have been cooked.

recipe:rolled-eggs-breakfast-wrap:step:4.en: Once the tortillas are done, finely grate the halloumi into a strip on one side of each omelette and cover with the roasted veggies, spinach and some hot sauce. Roll up the tortillas and wrap them in foil or parchment paper.

recipe:rolled-eggs-breakfast-wrap:step:5.en: These rolled egg wraps can be eaten fresh or stored in the freezer until ready to eat. Reheat from frozen in the microwave until defrosted, or pan fry on medium-low until thawed and piping hot throughout.

recipe:turkish-air-fryer-poached-eggs-re.en: Turkish Air Fryer Poached Eggs Recipe
Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl, zest in the lemon and finely grate in the garlic. Season with salt and black pepper and add a squeeze of lemon juice.

Put the butter into a small saucepan set over a medium-high heat. Keep whisking and stirring until the butter turns a light golden brown, then remove from the heat and add the olive oil and aleppo pepper. Season lightly and squeeze in a little lemon juice. Set aside.

Egg poaching time. Put four ovenproof ramekins into the basket of your air fryer. Boil the kettle and half fill the ramekins with boiling water. Crack an egg into each ramekin. Set the temperature to 200°C and cook the eggs for 5 mins until the whites are just set.
Meanwhile, divide the yoghurt between two shallow bowls, swirling it around the base of the bowls.
Carefully use a tea towel to lift out the ramekins from the air fryer, then use a spoon to free the eggs from the ramekins. Pat the eggs a little with kitchen paper and put on top of the yoghurt.
Briefly reheat the flavoured butter, then spoon all over the top.
Scatter with dill fronds and serve with the toasted bread to scoop up and the lemon halves for squeezing over, if you like.

recipe:turkish-air-fryer-poached-eggs-re.pt: 3 c. sopa de Azeite Virgem Extra
1 c. sopa de Pimenta de Aleppo

recipe:crunchy-egg-salad-bagels:step:0.en: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, then gently lower in the eggs and simmer for 8 mins to set the yolks. Transfer straight to a bowl of iced water. Once cool enough to handle, peel the eggs, cut them in half and separate the whites from the yolks.

recipe:crunchy-egg-salad-bagels:step:1.en: Mash the yolks in a large bowl until as smooth as you can. Add the yoghurt and Dijon mustard, then finely zest in the lemon and squeeze in the juice. Measure out the lime pickle, finely chop any chunky bits on a board, then add it to the bowl and mix everything together. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipe:crunchy-egg-salad-bagels:step:2.en: Finely chop the egg whites. Finely chop the almonds, celery, red onion and chives, then fold everything into the yolk mixture until evenly combined.

recipe:crunchy-egg-salad-bagels:step:3.en: To serve, toast the bagels. Slice the tomatoes. Spoon generous mounds of the crunchy egg salad onto the bagels and finish with the tomatoes on top.

recipe:squidgy-french-toast-dippers:step.en:
1 Adult Serving = 2 Kids Servings
Slice the brioche rolls in half through the middle, so you’ve got two long pieces from each.

Crack the eggs into a shallow dish. Add the milk, cinnamon and maple syrup or honey. Whisk everything together until well combined. Dunk the brioche into the eggy mixture, turning so they’re fully coated.

Melt a knob of butter in a large frying pan set over a medium heat. Let the excess egg drip off the brioche, then lay them into the pan. Fry for 2 mins on each side until golden and crisp. Work in batches if needed.

Serve up!
Kids Plate: Slice up the french toast into easy to grab dippers with a spoonful of yoghurt, fresh berries and a little drizzle of honey. 
Parents Plate: Serve up with yoghurt, berries and your favourite toppings.

recipe:salmon-tacos:name.en: Air Fryer Salmon Tacos with Mango Chipotle Glaze

recipe:salmon-tacos:step:0.en: Preheat the air fryer to high (240°C).

recipe:salmon-tacos:step:1.en: Dice the salmon into medium-sized cubes (about 3 per fillet). Season the salmon with salt and pop into a parchment lined pan or a tray. Mix together the chutney and the chipotle paste and tip over the salmon. Pop into the airfryer for 6-8 mins or until fully cooked, spooning any extra marinade over the fish as it cooks.

recipe:salmon-tacos:step:2.en: Thinly slice the cabbage and red onion and chuck into a bowl. Dress with a little salt and lime juice and toss through chopped dill. Thinly slice the scotch bonnet, season with salt and squeeze a little lime juice over the top.

recipe:salmon-tacos:step:3.en: Heat the tacos according to the package instructions.

recipe:salmon-tacos:step:4.en: Pull the fish out of the oven, it should be cooked and glazed in the spicy, smoky mango chipotle mix. (Flake it into smaller pieces, if you like.)

recipe:salmon-tacos:step:5.en: Build your tacos starting with the shells, topped with sour cream, some fish, a handful of slaw, the chillies and chopped spring onion and radishes. Get stuck in.

recipe:chargrilled-chicken-garlicky-broc.en: Finely chop the garlic. Chop the broccoli into small florets, smaller than you would usually.
Add half the olive oil to a large saucepan with a lid and set over a medium heat. Chuck in the garlic and cook for a couple of minutes until fragrant.
Tip in the rice and pour in the chicken stock. Bring to the boil, then cover with the lid, reduce the heat to low and cook for 4 mins.

After 4 mins, scatter the broccoli over the top. Give everything a quick stir, replace the lid and cook for another 8 mins. Turn off the heat and leave the rice to steam for 10 mins while you crack on with the chicken.

Place one of the chicken breasts between two sheets of baking paper and bash it with a rolling pin until about 1cm thick. Repeat with the rest of the chicken. Add the flattened chicken to a bowl with the remaining olive oil, ground cumin, a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Toss to coat.

Heat a large frying pan over a high heat. Once hot, add the chicken and cook for 3-4 mins on each side until well charred and cooked through. Transfer to a piece of foil, squeeze over the juice of the lemon and loosely seal to keep warm.
Finely chop the dill and stir it through the rice. Taste and season with more salt and pepper if needed.

Slice the chicken and serve it over the rice in Tupperware containers with a generous dollop of cottage cheese. Grate over a little lemon zest if you fancy. Once cooled, box up and pop in the fridge, ready for tomorrow’s lunch — they’ll keep for up to 3 days.

recipe:honey-gochujang-chicken-rigatoni:.en: Heat the oven to 200°C. Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil. Thinly slice the chives and grate the parmesan and set aside for later.
Drizzle the chicken breasts with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Wrap them in foil to make a tight parcel and place onto a tray. Roast for 15–20 mins until cooked through.
Once boiling, add the pasta to the water and cook according to pack instructions until al dente.

Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Stir in the gochujang and tomato purée. Let it cook for 2-3 mins until darkened and fragrant. Pour in the cream and stir through the honey and lime juice. Let it bubble gently until thickened slightly. Taste and season with salt and black pepper.
Once the chicken is cooked, using 2 forks shred the meat ready to add to the pasta.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the cooked pasta straight into the sauce, then toss through the shredded chicken until everything is glossy and coated.
Divide the pasta between bowls and finish with the grated Parmesan, a squeeze of lime juice and chopped chives.

recipe:honey-gochujang-chicken-rigatoni:.pt: 3 colheres de sopa de Concentrado de Tomate

recipe:pulled-chicken-miso-spring-onion-.en: Chicken, Miso & Spring Onion Smash Rice Bowl

Pop the water, two of the spring onions, the garlic and the fine salt into a large saucepan and set over a high heat. Bring to the boil, then throw in the chicken breasts. Bring back to a simmer, pop the lid on and turn off the heat. Leave untouched for 25 mins, the residual heat will cook the chicken through. Then using tongs, remove the chicken from the liquid and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile finely slice the remaining spring onions and celery. Roughly chop the coriander and 3/4 cucumber, thinly slicing the rest for garnish.

Once the chicken is cool enough to handle, shred into pieces using two forks. In a bowl, add the chicken, miso, mayonnaise and tahini, mixing well until evenly coated. Then fold through the 3/4 of the chopped spring onions, celery, coriander, cucumber and sesame seeds, until thick, creamy and scoopable. Season with black pepper and a little salt if needed.
Heat the rice and divide between bowls. Add a dollop of the chicken mixture with the sliced cucumber, remaining chopped spring onions and a drizzle of crispy chilli oil to finish.

recipe:pulled-chicken-miso-spring-onion-.pt: 2 Fatias de Pão de Fermentação Lenta
1 Saqueta de 250g de Arroz para Micro-ondas

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:step:0.en: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat. Add a splash of olive oil, then stir in the bulgur wheat. Fry for 2 mins until golden. Add the smoked paprika and cook for another 30 seconds. Cover with boiling water until 2cm above the bulgur, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 15 mins.

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:step:1.en: Make the tomato yoghurt dressing by blending the Greek yoghurt, sun-dried tomatoes, and lemon juice until smooth. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:step:2.en: Cut the halloumi into small 2cm-sized pieces. Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the halloumi pieces and cook on all sides until golden and charred. Pour in the pomegranate molasses and let it bubble and thicken, coating the halloumi.

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:step:3.en: Assemble the bowl: toss the sliced cherry tomatoes and most of the torn basil through the cooked bulgur wheat. Season with salt and black pepper.

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:step:4.en: Divide the bulgur into serving boxes. Top with the glazed halloumi, tomato yoghurt dressing, and mixed seeds. Garnish with the remaining basil leaves.

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:step:5.en: Refrigerate until needed. No need to reheat before serving.

recipe:marry-me-halloumi-bowl:ingredient.pt: 2 colheres de chá de Pimentão Fumado
2 colheres de sopa de Sementes Mistas
3 colheres de sopa de Melaço de Romã

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:0.en: Mince your garlic and slice your spring onion. Set aside in separate bowls.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:1.en: Peel your carrot and slice it into long strips. Halve your cucumber, remove the seeds, and then slice it into long strips like the carrot. Cut the tops off your radishes and thinly slice them. Place your prepped veg in a glass jar or deep bowl.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:2.en: Get a pot on medium heat and add your sugar, water and apple cider vinegar. Bring to a simmer then take it off the heat. Leave to cool then pour over your veg.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:3.en: Now, cook your sushi rice according to package instructions.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:4.en: Cut your tofu into small pieces and pat dry with a paper towel, this will absorb the water from the tofu.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:5.en: Place your tofu with the cornflour and garlic powder in a plastic bag or sealed container and give it a good shake.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:6.en: Get a wide, flat pan on medium heat, pour in a good glug of oil – enough so that it sits around 1½ cm high.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:7.en: When your oil is ready, give your tofu a shake to get rid of excess cornflour before popping it into your pan and frying until crispy. Place the fried tofu cubes on a paper towel-lined plate or sieve.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:8.en: Meanwhile, combine your gochujang, soy sauce, ketchup, maple syrup, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, and water with your minced garlic in a small bowl. Pour this mix into a pan and bring to a simmer. Take it off the heat and add your fried tofu, giving it a good toss.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:step:9.en: Serve your tofu with steamed rice, pickled veg and garnish with spring onions and toasted sesame seeds.

recipe:gochujang-tofu-rice-bowl:ingredie.pt: 150ml de Vinagre de Sidra de Maçã
1 colher de chá de Alho em Pó
2 colheres de sopa de Molho de Soja
2 colheres de sopa de Xarope de Ácer
1 colher de sopa de Vinagre de Vinho de Arroz
