recipe:jalepeno-coconut-chicken-thighs:s.en: Heat the oven to 220°C. Season the chicken thighs with salt.
Heat a large frying pan over medium heat (no oil). Add the desiccated coconut and cook, stirring constantly until golden and toasted, 2-4 mins. Tip onto a plate.
Put the chicken thighs into the empty pan, skin-side down, and cook for 8-10 mins until the skin is deep golden brown. Transfer to a baking tray.
Blend the sauce ingredients together until smooth. Taste and season with salt and pepper, if needed. Pour into the baking tray and transfer the chicken into the oven until cooked through, 30-40 mins.
Meanwhile, reheat the rice. Thinly slice the remaining jalapeño and cut the lime into wedges.
Once the chicken is cooked, serve the rice into bowls. Ladle in the sauce and top with the chicken. Finish with a sprinkling of the toasted coconut, jalapeño and a wedge of lime.

recipe:sticky-honey-gochujang-chicken-sa.en: Chicken & Rice Salad with Sticky Honey & Gochujang Dressing

Heat the oven to 200°C. Add the chicken breasts to a baking tray, drizzle with the olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Roast for 20 minutes, until cooked through, then remove and leave to cool slightly before shredding into bite-sized pieces.

Bring a pan of well-salted water to the boil. Halve the tenderstem broccoli and cook for 4 minutes, until just tender. Drain and leave to steam dry and cool. Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Halve the cucumber lengthways and cut into chunky, irregular pieces. Roughly crush the peanuts. Pick the coriander and mint leaves.

Now for the dressing. Peel and finely grate in the garlic into a bowl, then add the honey, gochujang, rice vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, water and sesame seeds. Whisk until everything's smooth and glossy.

Add the chicken, rice, broccoli, cucumber, herbs and peanuts to a large bowl. Pour over the dressing and toss everything together until well coated. Taste and season with a little salt if needed, then serve.

recipe:sticky-honey-gochujang-chicken-sa.pt: 2 Saquetas de Arroz Basmati para Micro-ondas

recipe:gnocchi-with-smashed-peas-lemon-p.en: Gnocchi with Smashed Peas, Lemon & Parmesan
dinner
Add all but a handful of the frozen peas to a blender or pestle and mortar and pulse/smash until pulpy.
Trim and slice the asparagus, and roughly chop the basil.

Bring a large pot of water to a boil, season with salt and blanch the gnocchi until they float to the top. Fish them out into a bowl and coat with a dash of oil. Grab yourself a mugful of the cooking water and save that for later.
Zest and juice the lemon and set aside for later.
Blanch the asparagus and that extra handful of peas for 1 min, drain and set aside.
Now, heat a large frying pan over a high heat. Add a shot of oil and let that get nice and hot.
Add the gnocchi and cook until golden brown. Keep the gnocchi moving regularly.
Add the butter and cook until brown and the gnocchi is glazed and nut brown.
Add a splash of the cooking water, the smashed peas and the crème fraîche. Toss everything together to create a beautifully green sauce. Finish with the lemon juice, to taste.
Season with salt and black pepper. Add lemon zest, Parmesan, the blanched veg and chopped basil.
Keep tossing everything together until glossy and gorgeous. Adjust the seasoning if you need to.
Divide between warm plates, top with more Parmesan and black pepper and get stuck in.

recipe:piri-piri-chicken-herby-lemon-chi.en: Piri Piri Chicken & Herby Lemon Chickpeas
Bash the chicken breasts between two sheets of baking paper until about 1cm thick. Drizzle with half the olive oil, sprinkle over the piri piri seasoning and season well with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a baking tray lined with foil and bake for about 12 mins, or until fully cooked. Set aside then slice before serving.
Meanwhile, finely slice the garlic. Using a vegetable peeler, peel off a few strips of lemon zest. Finely slice the red chilli, if using.

Heat the rest of the olive oil in a large frying pan set over a medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for a couple of minutes until just golden. Stir through the fennel seeds and chilli and let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Pour in the chickpeas along with around half of their liquid, add the lemon zest strips and season well with salt and pepper. Mix, then cover with a lid and simmer gently for 10 mins.
Finely chop the parsley. Take the pan off the heat and stir through the Greek yoghurt and most of the chopped parsley.

Slice the cooked chicken and serve it in a Tupperware container on top of the creamy chickpeas. Finish with a bit more parsley if you fancy. Once cooled, box up and pop in the fridge, ready for tomorrow’s lunch — they’ll keep for up to 3 days.

recipe:piri-piri-chicken-herby-lemon-chi.pt: 1 colher de chá de Sementes de Funcho
2 colheres de chá de Tempero Piri-Piri

recipe:harissa-courgette-grain-salad:nam.en: Harissa Courgette Grains with Tahini Dressing

recipe:harissa-courgette-grain-salad:ste.en:
Thinly slice the courgettes into half-moon shapes. Cut the lemon
in half.

Get a frying pan over a high heat and drizzle in a good glug
of olive oil. Chuck in the courgettes. Crush in the garlic cloves. Fry, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins until the
courgettes are softened and slightly charred.

Meanwhile, put the tahini in a small bowl and squeeze in the juice
from the lemon halves. Stir, then slowly mix in enough warm water
to make the dressing a thick drizzling consistency. (Adding the
lemon juice may make the tahini seize up at first, but when you
add the water it will turn smooth.) Season with salt and pepper.

Back to the courgettes. Add the harissa paste to taste. Squeeze
the unopened grain pouches with your hands to break up the
grains, then open and tip them into the pan along with a splash
of water. Stir and leave to heat through while you chop the dill.

Stir the chopped dill through the grain mixture, season to taste
with salt and pepper and pile onto a large serving dish. Drizzle
over the tahini dressing and serve with extra harissa, if you like.

recipe:harissa-courgette-grain-salad:ing.pt: 3 colheres de sopa de Pasta de Harissa

recipe:tuna-green-bean-chopped-salad:ste.en: Boil your green beans in water until soft, drain, and then allow to cool.
Chop and discard the heads off the pickled guindilla chillies. Add your beans to a chopping board along with your tuna and chillies and roughly chop them up.
Add in your capers and continue to chop.
Add all of your chopped ingredients to a bowl and squeeze in the juice from your lemons. Add in a good glug of olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper. Serve and enjoy!

recipe:healthy-green-queen-pasta:step:0.en: Cook the pasta in plenty of well-salted boiling water for 1 min less than the pack states. Drain, reserving the cooking water.

recipe:healthy-green-queen-pasta:step:1.en: Finely chop the shallot and crush the garlic. Add the onion to a wide frying pan set over a low-medium heat, season with salt and sauté for 10 mins, until trasnluscent. Add the garlic and fry for 2 mins.

recipe:healthy-green-queen-pasta:step:2.en: Fill a kettle and boil. Add the spinach and basil into a strainer and pour the boiling water over until wilted. Let cool down slightly and squeeze out any excess water. Add both to a blender with the onion and garlic, beans, lemon juice, nutritional yeast and pasta water, season generously, then blend until super smooth. Add more pasta water if you'd like it runnier. Season with more salt and pepper, if needed.

recipe:healthy-green-queen-pasta:step:3.en: To serve, combine the pasta and sauce, then top with vegan burrata. Finish with some freshly cracked black pepper.

recipe:healthy-green-queen-pasta:ingredi.pt: 300g de Massa de Sêmola de Trigo Duro
2 colheres de sopa de Levedura Nutricional
120ml de Água de Cozedura da Massa

recipe:lunch-box-chicken-basil-stir-fry:.en: Start by making the sauce. Add the oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce and sugar to a bowl. Mix until the sugar dissolves, then set aside.
Finely slice the shallots and chilli, and mince the garlic. Then roughly chop the tenderstem broccoli.
Set a large wok or frying pan over a medium heat and drizzle in the oil. Add the garlic, shallots and chilli, and stir-fry for 2–3 mins until fragrant.

Add the chicken mince and cook for 5-8 mins until golden, breaking it up with a spoon as you go (If you're making a bigger portion it's best to do this in batches, to allow the mince to fry properly). Pour in the sauce and let it bubble away for another 2 mins until sticky.

Tip in the broccoli and pour in the water. Cook for 3–4 mins until the beans are tender and most of the liquid has reduced. Add the basil and stir through to wilt. Finish by squeezing in the juice of half the limes.
For the eggs, either boil for 7 mins, then peel and store in the fridge, or fry them fresh when you’re ready to eat.

To portion, divide the cooked rice between four containers, then top with the chicken mince. This’ll keep in the fridge for up to 4 days. And serve with the remaining lime. Reheat until piping hot before serving.

recipe:lunch-box-chicken-basil-stir-fry:.pt: 3 colheres de sopa de Molho de Ostras
3 colheres de sopa de Molho de Soja Escuro
3 colheres de sopa de Molho de Peixe
2 colheres de sopa de Açúcar Refinado

recipe:chicken-caesar-chopped-salad:step.en: Heat the oven to 180°C. Put the two chicken breasts on a tray and drizzle with a little olive oil. Season well and slide into the oven and bake for 20 mins, until cooked through. Set aside until cool.
Tear the bread into chunky croutons, whack on a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Slide into the oven for 15 mins.
Bring a pan of salted water to the boil, drop in the Tenderstem broccoli and cook for 2 mins, then remove and set aside on a plate to cool.

Add the romaine lettuce halves to a board with the cooked chicken, Tenderstem broccoli and parmesan cheese. Chop together, then slide into a large bowl. Combine the dressing ingredients, then add the croutons and capers and drizzle with the dressing. Toss well then tip onto plates. Top with an extra grating of parmesan cheese.
